name: io.github.tonyyang0504/linkedin-social-mcp
description: LinkedIn (social): me, read_comments, reply_comment, read_mentions, delete, analytics_post. Every to

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client id of a LinkedIn app with the Community Management API product (scopes w_organization_social, r_organization_social, plus openid profile for me).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The app's client secret (form body of the refresh_token grant at https://www.linkedin.com/oauth/v2/accessToken).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LINKEDIN_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Programmatic refresh token from the 3-legged flow (approved Marketing/Community Management partners; valid about one year). The runtime mints 60-day access tokens from it.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LINKEDIN_AUTHOR_URN
environmentVariables.description: Organization URN the member administers and acts as, e.g. urn:li:organization:5515715 (comment actor and the organizationalEntity of read_mentions).
